name: Move Cleaning
description: Provides room-by-room cleaning checklists for move-in and move-out scenarios with specific tasks, time estimates, and security deposit recovery strategies. Covers the difference between move-out cleaning standards and regular cleaning, landlord inspection expectations, and DIY vs. professional cleaning cost comparisons. Use when the user is moving out of a rental and wants to maximize their security deposit return, moving into a new home and wants to clean before unpacking, or needs to prepare a home for new tenants. Do NOT use for regular cleaning routines (use weekly-cleaning-schedule), deep cleaning outside of a move context (use deep-cleaning-checklist), or post-construction cleaning.
